note:
USFS campground in Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area on Kentucky Lake.  Many sites are lakefront on peninsulas.  --AWH
Site water is shut off in spring and fall cold snaps; hydrants stay on. About a quarter of the sites go to a seasonal lottery. --Claude
summary: LBL's Piney confirmed: 384 sites (283 electric, 44 full hookup, 57 primitive), $12-42, Mar 1 - Nov 29, showers, laundry, Outpost store; books on LBL UseDirect (no rec.gov listing). Lakefront (--AWH) consistent with imagery. Pin is at the gatehouse ~520 m from the loops: move suggested. Phone added.
flags: PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 36.4868,-88.0339 is the gatehouse/office on Fort Henry Road; the camping loops fill the peninsula to the west, centre ~36.4855,-88.0395 (ball field in the middle of the loops), ~520 m away.

WATERFRONT --AWH lakefront not changed; imagery agrees: on the peninsula's west shore (e.g. ~36.4860,-88.0418 to 36.4848,-88.0415) pads sit ~10-30 m from the vegetated summer-pool line of Kentucky Lake under scattered trees; the lake was drawn down to bare beach at capture. Site numbers not available from the public sources read.
REC.GOV: no recreation.gov listing exists (search returned none); LBL books its four developed campgrounds on lblweb.usedirect.com/camplbl (#!park/1 = Piney), as stored.
LONG-STAY share: 98 of 384 sites (~26%) are in the 2027 seasonal lottery (three to nine months); the rest are nightly. A federal campground; noted, not a drop question.

SITES: max vehicle length per loop on UseDirect: Black Oak 1 41, Black Oak 2 31, Black Oak 3 35, Chestnut 45, Persimmon 30A 31, Sweetgum 50A 45, Shortleaf 24, Loblolly 41, Virginia (basic) 21, Dogwood EWS 32 ft - every hookup loop takes a 23-ft rig.
